user_instruction: 有效时间宽松计入正常思考、读写代码、评测、失败尝试和正常等待；不把失败请求整段自动扣掉；只扣已记录系统挂起及明确较长重试暂停，下载与停止空档仍排除；完整闭环另计。
failed_model_output_accounting: HTTP200 malformed output remains failed method work. A failed HTTP request does not by itself locate a stall; ordinary attempted-request waiting is included as an estimate. Quantified system suspension is deducted once and observed retry pauses >=5s are deducted.
excluded_without_counting: downloads and image/dependency preparation before agent execution
